_comment: SCAIL-2 3D 人物反抖动配方（v7 位置锁定+闭嘴版，配 可爱3D人物页面导览.png）。v6 基础上补嘴部钉死语（mouth stays closed and perfectly still / lips do not move / not talking），neg 补 talking/mouth movement/lips moving。实证：cfg=1 的 SCAIL 图里提示词绑定很弱，idle2 说话主要是 seed 层随机性（同配方 idle1=0.81/idle3=1.05 嘴静，idle2=11.26 在说），须重掷 seed 按 嘴/额差异比<=2 严选；剩余漂移靠几何稳定化兜底。
prompt: A cute stylized 3D animated character with a rounded, friendly face and big bright eyes stands calmly facing the camera. He stays fixed in the exact center of the frame with no position shift at all - his size on screen and his distance from the camera stay exactly the same from the first frame to the last, no zoom, no scale change, no growing larger or smaller, no moving closer or further away. His feet stay planted on exactly the same spot for the whole video, and his whole body holds one single fixed position in the frame from the first frame to the last. The camera is completely static. The background is a pure, solid black void - completely empty, with no walls, no floor, no furniture, no windows, no street, no lights and no environment details of any kind. The lighting is flat and dim, illuminating only the character himself, with no ambient spill, no glow and no color cast, so the background stays pure black in every single frame. His body, head and limbs hold steady and still, with no shaking, no trembling and no jitter. Both eyes are clearly open with natural highlights, looking directly at the camera. His mouth stays closed and perfectly still - his lips do not move at all, he is not talking and there is no mouth movement of any kind. The camera is fixed and static at a constant distance. His motions come entirely from the driving pose video. Stable, smooth, high quality video.
negative: zooming, camera zoom, scale change, growing larger, getting smaller, size change, getting closer to camera, moving away from camera, position shift, character moving in frame, off-center, camera movement, camera pan, shaky, trembling, jitter, sudden position change, sliding, drifting, shifting position, moving sideways, feet sliding, talking, mouth movement, lips moving, open mouth, mouth opening, speaking, blurry, flickering, morphing, distorted face, deformed, subtitles, text overlays, watermark
